items.prompt: For n=4, which is the largest possible leftover count before distributing extras?

options.why: The leftover is an integer sum of four fractional parts, each strictly below 1.
Four fractional parts below 1 cannot sum to 4.
Floor quotas have already allocated all but fewer than n units.
Noninteger quotas can leave positive units to distribute.
